---
title: "Roxygen suggestions, step by step"
description: "Each step of the roxygen suggestion workflow and the R functions behind it."
---

Part of [Under the hood](suggestions-internals.qmd): what the [roxygen suggestions](roxygen-suggest.qmd) do inside the R script, step by step.

Settings are read once; then each file goes through the same steps.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  subgraph once ["Once per run"]
    cfg["① Load settings"]
  end
  subgraph each ["For each file"]
    direction LR
    parse["② Read the function<br/>and its block"] --> ask["③ Ask Claude"]
    ask --> thr["④ Apply the<br/>threshold"]
    thr --> build["⑤ Build the<br/>new block"]
    build --> write["⑥ Write the file"]
    ask -. "no changes needed" .-> skip(["File left as is"])
    thr -. "nothing accepted" .-> skip
  end
  subgraph after ["After the last file"]
    report["⑦ Write the report"]
  end
  once --> each --> after
```

## ① Load settings

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`resolve_shared_path()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/resolve_shared_path.R) | Finds a settings or prompt file: your repository's own copy if it has one ([override](suggestions.qmd#adjusting-the-guidance)), otherwise the shared one. |
| [`read_json_config()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/read_json_config.R) | Reads a JSON settings file, e.g. the style guide `config/roxygen-style.json`. |
| [`read_text_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/read_text_file.R) | Reads the prompt template `prompts/roxygen-review-prompt.md`. |
| [`read_package_name()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/read_package_name.R) | Reads the package name from `DESCRIPTION`. |
| [`check_datashield_type()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/check_datashield_type.R) | DataSHIELD: stops the run if `datashield-type` isn't `client`, `server` or `utility`. |
| [`read_package_dependencies()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/read_package_dependencies.R) | DataSHIELD utility packages: reads `Depends` and `Imports` from `DESCRIPTION`, to find a study group through them (e.g. `dsBaseClient`). |
| [`find_study_group()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/find_study_group.R) | DataSHIELD clients and utility packages: finds the demo-server study group that fits this package, for ready-made login examples. |
| [`build_demo_login_snippet()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/build_demo_login_snippet.R) | DataSHIELD clients and utility packages: builds the multi-study login code to use in `@examples`. |
| [`role_guidance()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/role_guidance.R) | DataSHIELD: picks the client, server or utility guidance (e.g. about disclosure control) and adds the login example. A utility package also gets a version without it, for functions that don't use connections. |
| [`build_role_guidance_text()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/build_role_guidance_text.R) | Turns that guidance from the settings file into a paragraph for the prompt. |

The Claude settings (model, `accept_reasons`, `code_issue_confidence`, …)
come from `config/claude.yml`, profile `roxygen-review`.

With an open suggestion PR to build on (a PR or push run), its findings
are read too:

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`fetch_suggestion_pr_body()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fetch_suggestion_pr_body.R) | The description of the open suggestion PR for this branch, if there is one. |
| [`decode_suggestion_state()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/decode_suggestion_state.R) | Reads the findings of earlier runs, kept hidden in that description. |
| [`fetch_bot_branch()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fetch_bot_branch.R) | Fetches the suggestion branch, to read the blocks it already proposes. |

## ② Read the function

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`parse_r_file()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/parse_r_file.R) | Finds the first function in the file, its parameters and the roxygen block above it, with every tag and its lines. |
| [`review_source_block()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/review_source_block.R) | With an open suggestion PR: reviews the block it already proposes instead of yours, so the same fixes aren't suggested again — unless you edited the documentation since the last review; then yours counts. |
| [`select_profile()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/select_profile.R) | Picks the style guidance for an exported or an internal function (by `@export`). |
| [`fn_source()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fn_source.R) | Cuts out the function's source code, so Claude can check the documentation against it. |
| [`uses_ds_connections()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/uses_ds_connections.R) | DataSHIELD utility packages: whether the function works on DataSHIELD connections (a `datasources` argument, `datashield.*()` or `ds.*()` calls). Only then does its guidance include the login example. |

## ③ Ask Claude

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ask_claude_for_review()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/ask_claude_for_review.R) | Prepares and sends the review request; returns Claude's fields. |
| [`build_guidance_text()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/build_guidance_text.R) | Turns the style guide's per-tag rules into a list for the prompt. |
| [`fill_template()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/fill_template.R) | Fills the prompt template's `{{PLACEHOLDERS}}` with the function, its block and the guidance. |
| [`format_earlier_findings()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/format_earlier_findings.R) | Lists the open earlier findings on the function (not applied suggestions, possible bugs) for the prompt, each with an id. |
| [`build_submit_review_tool()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/build_submit_review_tool.R) | Defines the form Claude fills in: one field per documentation part and parameter, a list of changes with a reason each, possible code bugs (reasoning first, then a verdict, a confidence and the one-line summary), and with earlier findings which of them a new one repeats and whether each still holds. |
| [`suggestion_reasons()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/suggestion_reasons.R) | The fixed list of reasons Claude may give (`missing`, `inaccurate`, `incomplete`, `clarity`, `style`). |
| [`call_claude_tool()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/call_claude_tool.R) | Sends the request to the Claude API and returns the filled-in form; stops with a clear error if the answer was cut off or refused. |

## ④ Apply the threshold

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`accepted_roxygen_fields()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/accepted_roxygen_fields.R) | Keeps a change only if its reason is accepted and the text really differs (more than whitespace, punctuation or case). Records applied and dropped changes for the report. |
| [`original_roxygen_field()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/original_roxygen_field.R) | The current text of one documentation part, for the comparison. |
| [`implicit_roxygen_field()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/implicit_roxygen_field.R) | The same for a title or description written without a tag (the first lines of the block). |
| [`roxygen_field_text()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/roxygen_field_text.R) | Claude's new text for one documentation part. |
| [`kept_code_issues()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/kept_code_issues.R) | Keeps a possible bug only if Claude concluded it is a defect, with one of the confidence levels to report. |
| [`code_issue_confidence_levels()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/code_issue_confidence_levels.R) | Those levels: the `code-issue-confidence` input, else `code_issue_confidence` in `config/claude.yml` (high and medium); `none` means possible bugs aren't asked for and the report has no such section. Stops on an unknown level. |

## ⑤ Build the block and ⑥ write the file

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build_roxygen_block()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/build_roxygen_block.R) | Assembles the new block in the configured tag order: accepted parts from Claude, all other lines and tags (`@export`, `@seealso`, …) exactly as they were. |
| [`strip_artifact_lines()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/strip_artifact_lines.R) | Removes stray `#'` or `@tag` lines Claude might have copied into a field; an empty required field stops the file instead of breaking it. |
| [`write_in_place()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/write_in_place.R) | Replaces the old block with the new one in the file. |

## ⑦ Write the report

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`merge_roxygen_findings()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/merge_roxygen_findings.R) | After each file: merges its findings with the earlier ones — repeats skipped, earlier findings that no longer hold or were replaced crossed out, never deleted. |
| [`format_roxygen_summary()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/format_roxygen_summary.R) | The summary line of the open findings, e.g. "8 changes applied · 3 not applied · 1 possible bug". |
| [`format_roxygen_report()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/format_roxygen_report.R) | The suggestion PR's description, rebuilt from all findings on every run: applied changes per file, not applied ones per reason with Claude's proposed text, and what the latest review changed. |
| [`format_code_issues()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/format_code_issues.R) | The "Possible bugs in the code" section. |
| [`finding_line()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/finding_line.R), [`group_title()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/group_title.R) | One finding with the commit it came from — crossed out with when and why if it no longer holds — and a group's title with its counts. |
| [`encode_suggestion_state()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/encode_suggestion_state.R) | Stores all findings hidden in the description, for the next run. |
| [`comment_once()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/shared/comment_once.R) | Without a suggestion PR: posts the possible bugs as a comment on your PR, but not again on the next push. |
| [`report_sweep_code_issues()`](https://github.com/FlorianSchw/package-workflows/blob/main/R/functions/roxygen/report_sweep_code_issues.R) | A sweep without a suggestion PR: puts the possible bugs into that month's issue. |
